body:
Independent Assessment Roots were serialized by RabbitMQ prefetch one despite available workers, and reconnect/timeout submissions could outgrow execution capacity. This change preserves the existing broker/executor/API-lease architecture with bounded credit and isolated contexts. Production remains fixed at **2 boundary workers / prefetch 2 / Agent Server capacity 2**; read-only researcher concurrency remains one.

Recovery also closes two acceptance defects: six unconditional-rule packets could omit their source-declared actor/activity scope, and the actual INCEPTION/mercury-3 route was absent from the official-reference price registry. The existing validator now requires referenced `OPERATIVE_SCOPE` findings, revalidates replay, and remains the Completion Gate authority. Unknown deployment facts support neither applicability verdict. The immutable Mercury 3 launch-price version uses captured official rates and preserves historical unpriced snapshots.

**Implementation HEAD:** `44dba336f332d566d3fee9fc0d32642a402d024e`  
**Production:** exact fast-forward-pulled HEAD; API, Web, host runtime and sandbox image rebuilt. Image `sha256:0039d8bc2a963bf5d517e7732297c30ef9d8ffd7c56caeacc29378e9852e14e5`; health 200; configuration fingerprints unchanged.

Fresh production proof: **194.436 seconds of actual cross-account Root overlap**, **8.351 seconds of concurrent model execution**, maximum two Roots, third-case queue/handoff, Stop A while B advances, canonical Continue, isolated timelines/checkpoints/sandboxes and cross-owner 404s. Sixty-five physical attempts and 130 delivered callback transitions reconcile. Sixty-four settled attempts have exact reference estimates totaling **$0.12887046 known cost**; one failed attempt retains UNKNOWN cost/missing usage and a partial aggregate. This is reference consumption accounting, not provider invoice or customer wallet certification.

Validation: exact-head **36 successful CI checks**. Local Python 2,005 pass/25 skip; API 1,517 pass/129 skip; API E2E 175 pass/22 skip; real broker/admission 142 pass; real API/DB/native Root vertical 149 checks; HITL/checkpoint 72 checks. Six historical semantic negative controls and six live positive controls pass, with final native checkpoint-resume proof. Earlier failed/inconclusive probes and deployment setup failures are preserved.

**Release disposition: OVERALL BLOCKED.** Fresh proctoring/credit benchmarks legitimately wait for unknown operational facts and have no final reports. Fresh production report generation has not been demonstrated on this revision. Existing report read/download integrity and real API/DB/scripted-Root report contracts pass, but do not substitute for that gate. The documented exposed local DB credential was rotated, with old-auth rejection proof. No unrelated production data/configuration was changed.

[Updated A–K report and acceptance matrix](https://github.com/khov4nfs/LCSP/blob/5630821e5f7f241eb511e0856244d5a0ea3a2758/reports/lcsp346-concurrency/70dc0a6fe/continuation/README.md) · [Sanitized traces, screenshots, checksums and tests](https://github.com/khov4nfs/LCSP/tree/5630821e5f7f241eb511e0856244d5a0ea3a2758/reports/lcsp346-concurrency/70dc0a6fe/continuation/recovery-44dba336f) · [Jira LCSP-346](https://minhpnq1807.atlassian.net/browse/LCSP-346).

Normal review is requested; the existing `khov4nfs` reviewer request remains. Do not merge or mark Jira Done before required acceptance/approval. LCSP-364 autoscaling remains separate; its architectural handoff is documented. No LCSP-345/347 implementation or new decision authority is included.
